title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented Seattle University environments for focused work, collaborative projects, creative production, and identity-centered study time.

cards.title: Lemieux Library
cards.subtitle: Lemieux Library & McGoldrick Learning Commons
cards.notes: Set up near the center of campus for reading or project work; use the connected Student Center walkway when planning your route.
cards.short_summary: A light-filled campus library supporting individual study, group work, and creative projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Seattle University describes Lemieux Library as a space for studying, group work, and creative projects, with modern lab spaces.
cards.access_notes: An SU ID card is required for building access during Summer Quarter and Intersession.

cards.title: Billodue Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Sinegal Center
cards.notes: Bring a project idea and use the space’s fabrication tools or join a listed making activity to turn course concepts into physical work.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on learning space for digital fabrication, repair, fiber arts, and more.
cards.evidence_claim: The Billodue Makerspace is open to all Seattle University students and majors and offers activities including fiber arts, repair, laser cutting, and 3D printing.
cards.access_notes: Seattle University states the makerspace is open to all students and all majors; confirm equipment availability before visiting.

cards.title: Media Production Center
cards.subtitle: Lemieux Library & McGoldrick Learning Commons
cards.notes: Use the studio or editing-room equipment for a media assignment, then reserve enough time to export and review your final files.
cards.short_summary: A production-focused space with studio, editing, and screening-room resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Media Production Center is available to all students and provides studio and editing-room equipment for video, photography, and audio production.
cards.access_notes: Available to all Seattle University students; review program offerings and equipment procedures before use.

cards.title: Veteran & Military-Connected Link
cards.subtitle: The Links by the MOSAIC Center
cards.notes: Use the tables, seating, and available study-room features for a focused session; check the current Link-hours graphic before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A MOSAIC Center community space with study-friendly furnishings and features.
cards.evidence_claim: Seattle University identifies the Veteran & Military-Connected Link as a Link space; Link spaces include tables, chairs, couches, and may have study rooms.
cards.access_notes: All students may check out Link spaces; all Links are closed weekends and holidays.

cards.title: Pride Link
cards.subtitle: The Links by the MOSAIC Center
cards.notes: Bring a reading or laptop task and use the shared tables or lounge seating; consult the current Link-hours graphic before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A MOSAIC Center community space that can support informal study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Seattle University lists Pride Link among its Link spaces, which are equipped with tables, chairs, couches, and additional features that can include study rooms.
cards.access_notes: All students may check out Link spaces; all Links are closed weekends and holidays.

cards.title: Commuter & Transfer Link
cards.subtitle: The Links by the MOSAIC Center
cards.notes: Use this Link for a between-classes work block, taking advantage of its seating and study-oriented features; verify hours first.
cards.short_summary: A campus community space with tables, couches, and potential study-room access.
cards.evidence_claim: Seattle University identifies the Commuter & Transfer Link as a Link space; every Link space has tables, chairs, couches, and additional features such as study rooms.
cards.access_notes: All students may check out Link spaces; all Links are closed weekends and holidays.

cards.title: Graduate Student & Adult Learner Link
cards.subtitle: The Links by the MOSAIC Center
cards.notes: Choose a table or couch for independent work, and ask the MOSAIC Center about the Link’s specific study-room or shared-space setup.
cards.short_summary: A Link space supporting a campus learning community with flexible seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Seattle University lists the Graduate Student & Adult Learner Link among its Link spaces, which have tables, chairs, couches, and other features including study rooms.
cards.access_notes: All students may check out Link spaces; all Links are closed weekends and holidays.

cards.title: Intercultural Link
cards.subtitle: The Links by the MOSAIC Center
cards.notes: Settle in with course reading at a table or couch and check with staff about any study-room use or scheduled community programming.
cards.short_summary: A MOSAIC Center Link space with flexible, community-oriented study furnishings.
cards.evidence_claim: Seattle University identifies the Intercultural Link as a Link space; Link spaces are equipped with tables, chairs, couches, and additional features including study rooms.
cards.access_notes: All students may check out Link spaces; all Links are closed weekends and holidays.

cards.title: First-Gen Link
cards.subtitle: The Links by the MOSAIC Center
cards.notes: Use the shared seating for a low-key work session and check the current hours image before visiting, especially near holidays.
cards.short_summary: A campus Link space with tables, couches, and community-support resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Seattle University lists First-Gen Link as one of its Link spaces; each Link has tables, chairs, couches, and may include study rooms.
cards.access_notes: All students may check out Link spaces; all Links are closed weekends and holidays.

cards.entity_name: Seattle University Law Library Fourth Floor
cards.title: Seattle University Law Library Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Sullivan Hall
cards.notes: Choose this floor when silence matters, keep phones quiet, and use the library’s individual-study setting for concentrated reading or outlining.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent floor in the law library’s four-floor Sullivan Hall location.
cards.evidence_claim: Seattle University School of Law designates the Law Library’s fourth floor as a silent floor and states that carrels are available throughout the library.
cards.access_notes: Follow Law Library noise policies; carrels may not be held exclusively, and they are law-student-only during exam periods.
